tools.name: hero_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts (customers and others) with number, name, company, email, phone and address. Filter by category (for example 'customer'). Page with offset. HERO GraphQL query: contacts.

tools.name: hero_list_projects
tools.description: List projects with project number, trade (measure), customer, contact person, project address and status. Pass ids to fetch only some projects. HERO GraphQL query: project_matches.

tools.name: hero_get_project
tools.description: Get one project by id with its customer documents (type, number, value, file link) and its history entries (log book). HERO GraphQL query: project_matches(ids).

tools.name: hero_list_documents
tools.description: List customer documents (offers, invoices and so on) with number, date, value, VAT, status, document type and file link. HERO GraphQL query: customer_documents.

tools.name: hero_run_query
tools.description: Run any read-only GraphQL query on the HERO API, for example calendar_events or supply_product_versions, or a schema introspection ({ __schema { queryType { fields { name } } } }). Mutations and subscriptions are refused. The schema is only visible by introspection with your key.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: hero_list_contacts · Private data: hero_list_contacts, hero_list_projects, hero_get_project, hero_list_documents · Public sink: hero_list_contacts · Destructive: hero_run_query.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: hero_list_contacts · Private data: hero_list_contacts, hero_list_projects, hero_get_project, hero_list_documents · Public sink: hero_list_contacts · Destructive: hero_run_query

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
